contract.definition: u : User = User.allInstances()->any(x : User | x.UserID = uid), c : BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y : BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode)
contract.precondition: User.allInstances()->one(x : User | x.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->one(y : BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode and y.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and y.IsReserved = false) and Reserve.allInstances()->forAll(r : Reserve | r.ReservedCopy <> c or r.IsReserveClosed = true)
contract.postcondition: c.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and c.IsReserved = true and Reserve.allInstances()->exists(r : Reserve | r.oclIsNew() and r.ReserveDate = Today and r.IsReserveClosed = false and r.ReservedUser = u and r.ReservedCopy = c and Reserve.allInstances()->includes(r) and u.ReservedBook->includes(r) and c.ReservationRecord->includes(r)) and result = true
